Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 57, "heading": "CHAPTER 55. TEMPEST", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u057-b0058", "target": "Против такого зрелища и против такой решимости, как у этого спокойно-отчаянного человека, уже привыкшего вести за собой половину присутствующих, я с тем же успехом мог бы умолять ветер. — Мас’р Дэви, — сказал он, бодро хватая меня за обе руки, — коли мой час пришёл, так пришёл. А коли нет, подожду. Господь на небесах благослови вас и благослови всех! Товарищи, снаряжайте меня! Я иду!", "source_sha256": "cbcd2197dba3f70fd1aba9eeafb928382e1562705fd3b0575257cada7553a426", "target_id": "ru-en85-u057-b0058", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "8c2533c2a72895531ed5a036938a0a8e721c0fbbb0feb21a85367b6c01660757"}, {"source_id": "en85-u057-b0059", "target": "Меня оттащили — но не грубо — на некоторое расстояние, где окружавшие меня люди заставили меня остаться; уговаривая, как я смутно понял, что он решил идти, с помощью или без неё, и что я нарушу меры, принятые для его безопасности, если стану тревожить тех, на ком они держатся. Не знаю, что я ответил, что они возразили; но я увидел суету на берегу и людей, бегущих с канатами от стоявшего там кабестана и проникающих в круг фигур, скрывших его от меня. Затем я увидел его стоящим одного, в матросской рубахе и штанах: канат в руке или обвязан вокруг запястья; другой — вокруг тела; и несколько лучших людей, державших на небольшом расстоянии за этот последний, который он сам уложил свободными кольцами на берегу у своих ног.", "source_sha256": "ba47f5905bf3e07d7d25af1799ad51c145490dff73e53b50607ea0169ee6e7a3", "target_id": "ru-en85-u057-b0059", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d6abdbb21731732bbb7810c111ebd5bcd15b2343dc7a37b155749ae9f087f317"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 55, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u057-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The wreck, even to my unpractised eye, was breaking up. I saw that she was parting in the middle, and that the life of the solitary man upon the mast hung by a thread. Still, he clung to it. He had a singular red cap on,—not like a sailor’s cap, but of a finer colour; and as the few yielding planks between him and destruction rolled and bulged, and his anticipative death-knell rung, he was seen by all of us to wave it. I saw him do it now, and thought I was going distracted, when his action brought an old remembrance to my mind of a once dear friend.", "sha256": "abb69381766b6c5ac42a949e48ea5426cd00c30ffca6bd25343d46e3061bd084", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Ham watched the sea, standing alone, with the silence of suspended breath behind him, and the storm before, until there was a great retiring wave, when, with a backward glance at those who held the rope which was made fast round his body, he dashed in after it, and in a moment was buffeting with the water; rising with the hills, falling with the valleys, lost beneath the foam; then drawn again to land. They hauled in hastily.", "sha256": "c7854c2554cbc86db227c8b7eec5264e6f7d8b8f906b365e61277e270ffeb585", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He was hurt. I saw blood on his face, from where I stood; but he took no thought of that. He seemed hurriedly to give them some directions for leaving him more free—or so I judged from the motion of his arm—and was gone as before.", "sha256": "d5687034fcb8a59205deff58c58cc6cd564622e14a3989feae7d0f35fc2f0973", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "And now he made for the wreck, rising with the hills, falling with the valleys, lost beneath the rugged foam, borne in towards the shore, borne on towards the ship, striving hard and valiantly. The distance was nothing, but the power of the sea and wind made the strife deadly. At length he neared the wreck. He was so near, that with one more of his vigorous strokes he would be clinging to it,—when a high, green, vast hill-side of water, moving on shoreward, from beyond the ship, he seemed to leap up into it with a mighty bound, and the ship was gone!", "sha256": "eeef220543feb12139e40795a140c5afa9f849a310b91e701de632680f522a04", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Some eddying fragments I saw in the sea, as if a mere cask had been broken, in running to the spot where they were hauling in. Consternation was in every face. They drew him to my very feet—insensible—dead. He was carried to the nearest house; and, no one preventing me now, I remained near him, busy, while every means of restoration were tried; but he had been beaten to death by the great wave, and his generous heart was stilled for ever.", "sha256": "da50cd6ddb07239bb1905aa29a89b6fba6764ac1e7825c1a430763df9c35f5df", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[64]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "As I sat beside the bed, when hope was abandoned and all was done, a fisherman, who had known me when Emily and I were children, and ever since, whispered my name at the door.", "sha256": "42fb79568ee127bd217c922449674cd97deb0401c8fcd3593448906f4346d77f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Sir,’ said he, with tears starting to his weather-beaten face, which, with his trembling lips, was ashy pale, ‘will you come over yonder?’", "sha256": "62bd9dd8fb8c30fcaa47a3dff2284b60ffe734173fd47f80cb825533336c4ef5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "The old remembrance that had been recalled to me, was in his look. I asked him, terror-stricken, leaning on the arm he held out to support me:", "sha256": "bd395b7ff0353ba7f12fe3df8d0185a53878f0268e3eee1cd30c845bfcbe2cd0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Has a body come ashore?’", "sha256": "95e0dbc0c2330b18d2afa44f212fd04ee91924d8d519a3c2d26b5c736e2e208d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He said, ‘Yes.’", "sha256": "59e6a6256fceb1dcf89ab888a97ca900ea8a01193452b6502a50cf41470123ba", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0070", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Do I know it?’ I asked then.", "sha256": "9ab6b1b5bb59357c81b417353562900fd179ed002ac269e471e80e7b8cc2c811", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[70]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0071", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "He answered nothing.", "sha256": "26f834943cd2b2ce81c267f0ccc7da460fb1d3f5651068dea65d869f96c5d330", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[71]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u057-b0072", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "But he led me to the shore. And on that part of it where she and I had looked for shells, two children—on that part of it where some lighter fragments of the old boat, blown down last night, had been scattered by the wind—among the ruins of the home he had wronged—I saw him lying with his head upon his arm, as I had often seen him lie at school.", "sha256": "8ecfc29e5bd5897cac6a03670357c69a8cb8b716660e1ddef9cead0da7c5f142", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[62]/p[72]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
